title: Clipboard button
description: A button that copies text to the clipboard and confirms it. The text is its clipboardText, or the text of the element its target selector names.

clipboardText.description: The text to copy. `text` is accepted as well.

target.description: CSS selector of an element whose text is copied when clipboardText is empty.

label.description: The button's text when it has none of its own.

feedback.description: Shown on the button for 2 seconds after a successful copy.
feedback.visualReason: Shown only after a click copies text; a button at rest looks the same either way.

_metadata.derivedFrom: src/wb-viewmodels/helpers.js — every property here is one the behavior reads
